name: AcyMailing
line: WordPress and Joomla email campaigns with a separate app email API.

cells.api: Yes; plugin REST API needs Essential or above

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 emails a month. The Essential bundle allows 4,000 emails a month.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 emails a month. The Essential bundle allows 20,000 emails a month.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 emails a month. The Essential bundle allows 40,000 emails a month.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 emails a month. The Essential bundle allows 200,000 emails a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 app emails a month fit inside the next bundle, which allows 4,000 emails a month.
10,000 app emails a month fit inside the next bundle, which allows 12,000 emails a month.
50,000 app emails a month fit inside the next bundle, which allows 80,000 emails a month.
100,000 app emails a month fit inside the next bundle, which allows 120,000 emails a month.
